answer: Cross-epoch beacon drift scoring. Each epoch, an agent's interactions emit a behavioural echo compared against its prior-epoch profile; cosine drift beyond a threshold flags the identity for revalidation. A shared cedar token seeds the epoch comparison so colluding clones can't pre-coordinate matching histories. Attacker cost: every fake identity must sustain coherent multi-epoch behaviour, multiplying per-identity compute and data costs by the number of epochs checked.
